decisions.reason: Locked label is right. cp 46889 is the DOI in the query of the publisher URL https://journals.plos.org/plosmedicine/article?id=10.1371/journal.pmed.1000084 in the مسار= (url=) field of the PLoS Med citation. The path is /plosmedicine/article, not /doi/, so 3.5's 'anything else' row applies and the raw text is the identifier text, as locked. url= pointing at the identifier is identifier_link. Key 10.1371/journal.pmed.1000084 is right. The doi= field (cp 46804) and the archive snapshot (cp 47020, not_a_target) are separate items.
